cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix your kettle for a spoonful of yesterday. Remember, I taught you never to do a repair for nothing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning. You still hover over the kettle instead of getting the cups ready.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've finally checked the date. Leave the spoon beside the kettle overnight; by morning you can pay me and we'll start the repair.

reason: Give the former pupil a relevant remembered habit or taught action that determines A bargain, definition, assignment or ritual. Preserve original causal offers and make B participation materially necessary.
